title: BATHYS
description: Autonomous hadal exploration vehicles engineered for the 11,000-metre breach. Pinned hydrostatic dive stage with live pressure gauge, water-column absorption, and procedural acoustic sonar.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · Canvas Sonar · Hydrostatic Physics

sections.title: Fixed Telemetry Header HUD
sections.summary: Brand mark lockup, live depth and bar pressure readout pills, coordinate status, navigation anchors, and "Commission Payload" CTA.

sections.title: The Hadal Descent Stage (Signature Mechanic)
sections.summary: - Pinned 320vh stage (0 to 10,928 m) with dual-column telemetry and right-hand bathymetric rail.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Procedural Sonar Radar
sections.summary: - Real-time HTML5 Canvas polar sweep radar with concentric range circles (2km, 5km, 10km) and rotating sector beam.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Vehicle Architecture
sections.summary: - Exploded vector blueprint schematic highlighting the Titanium Pressure Sphere, Syntactic Foam Buoyancy Core, Magnetic Thruster Pods, and Dielectric Lithium-Sulfur Battery Tray.

sections.title: Sensor Suite
sections.summary: - 3D perspective cards with hover tilt and pointer spotlights featuring Synthetic Aperture Sonar, Ultra-Deep CTD Probe, Laser Raman Spectrometer, and Isobaric Benthic Corer.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Field Operations Dossiers
sections.summary: - Operational mission logs from the Challenger Deep (10,928m), Puerto Rico Trench (8,376m), and Kermadec Trench (10,047m).

sections.title: Charter & Payload Intake Form
sections.summary: - Client-side validated form (principal investigator name, institutional email, agency, target trench, payload mass kg, requirements) with zero network calls and accessible status feedback.

sections.title: Colophon & Hydrographic Registry Footer
sections.summary: - Brest and Monterey foundry coordinates, IMO Subsea Category H-11 certification, and smooth "Return to Surface" scroll action.
